walkthrough.short: Join one hand with {pairs}, the lark puts it up, the robin walks under: you trade places and face back.
walkthrough.long: Join one hand with {pairs} — the lark's right in the robin's left — and the lark puts it up into an arch. Come together and walk forward: the robin goes under the arch, turning tight inside it, while the lark walks round the outside of her. You trade places and end facing back the way you came, the hand held throughout. It works from side by side or from face to face. {where}
